summary: Cessna Aircraft Field (CEA) is a small general aviation airport located in Wichita, Kansas, the historic 'Air Capital of the World.' The field serves as a key facility associated with Cessna, now part of Textron Aviation, one of the world's largest manufacturers of general aviation aircraft. It primarily supports company operations, test flights, and corporate aviation rather than scheduled commercial service.
faqs:
Q: Does Cessna Aircraft Field offer commercial passenger service?
A: No, CEA is a private general aviation facility that does not provide scheduled commercial flights. It primarily supports corporate, test, and private aviation activities.

Q: Who uses Cessna Aircraft Field?
A: The airport is closely associated with Textron Aviation (Cessna) and is used for company aircraft, test flights, and general aviation visitors.

Q: Are there public facilities available at CEA?
A: Access is generally restricted due to its corporate association, so travelers should coordinate with the facility or their handler before arriving.

Q: What is the closest major commercial airport?
A: Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport (ICT) is the nearest airport offering commercial airline service, located a short drive north in Wichita.
transport_tips: A personal vehicle or pre-arranged ground transportation is the most practical way to reach Cessna Aircraft Field, as it is not served by public transit. Rental cars and rideshare services are readily available throughout the Wichita metro area. If arriving for business with Textron Aviation, confirm parking or shuttle arrangements with your host in advance.
local_tip: If you have time before or after your visit, stop by the Kansas Aviation Museum near McConnell AFB to see historic aircraft and learn about Wichita's century-long role as the center of American aviation manufacturing.
